tool_limitations.limitation: Directory-only discovery is incomplete for old-style projects that use external Include plus Link metadata.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse project items, expand common MSBuild properties, and copy external items to their logical Link paths before triage.

tool_limitations.limitation: Build output discovery assumed an explicit Platform path.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Find the newest complete exe plus AppxManifest layout recursively under bin.

tool_limitations.limitation: WMC9999 was described as uniquely indicating a missing resource even when earlier compiler errors caused the secondary crash.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Require fixing preceding CS/WMC diagnostics first and treat missing resources as one fallback hypothesis.

doc_errors.wrong: Treat WMC9999 as a dangling resource key.
doc_errors.correct: WMC9999 is a secondary XAML compiler crash; fix earlier actionable diagnostics first, then investigate resource keys if no earlier cause remains.

special_apis.special_handling: The Windows API carried over and compiled in WinUI 3; device/service unavailability was represented by the sample's existing visible error states.
When Windows.System and Microsoft.UI.Dispatching are both imported, qualify Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue to avoid CS0104.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The bootstrap and self-check were launched concurrently, so the check raced artifact creation.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent reran Test-Path after bootstrap completed and received True.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The environment had no Python command, and the agent attempted to use it for assembly inspection.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent switched to PowerShell, then abandoned binary reflection and searched generated source.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The selected DLL was .NET Native UWP output, not a normal managed assembly loadable by Add-Type.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent inspected generated SafeTypes.g.cs instead.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Windows.ApplicationModel.Activation and Microsoft.UI.Xaml both supplied a type with that name.
errors_encountered.fix: The WinUI parameter was fully qualified and the stale activation import was later removed.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Windows.System and Microsoft.UI.Dispatching were both imported.
errors_encountered.fix: The field and factory call were fully qualified as Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The XAML compiler could not resolve the local DataTemplate type; WMC9999 was a secondary internal failure, not proof of a missing resource.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent replaced that template binding with DisplayMemberPath after inspecting generated XAML output.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103 Launcher does not exist in the current context.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The reconstructed shared shell omitted the Windows.System qualification/import.
errors_encountered.fix: The call was changed to Windows.System.Launcher.LaunchUriAsync.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable after a successful build.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The script searched only platform-qualified output while dotnet build emitted bin\Debug\...\win-x64.
errors_encountered.fix: Validate-UwpMigration rebuilt with Platform=x64 and its smoke launch passed.

errors_encountered.error: Migration trial results recorded timeout=true, builds=false, runs=false.
errors_encountered.root_cause: After validator PASS, the agent started foreground dotnet run and ended while it remained running.
errors_encountered.fix: The scoring trial independently rebuilt and exercised the candidate; future runs should stop after the validated detached smoke launch.

dev_agent_struggles.where: Shared shell and scenario discovery, turns 4-18
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent browsed SharedContent, generated UWP files, and ILC metadata, then manually recreated App, MainPage, scenario XAML, styles, and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately 15 turns before the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap copied only 4 local files and omitted 16 linked project items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent inferred linked inputs from the csproj and reconstructed/copied them manually.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 resolve csproj Include/Link items into the bootstrap inventory.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Python was unavailable, Add-Type rejected native IL, and the agent searched large generated sources.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Two failed tool attempts followed by generated-source grep.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manual reconstruction led the agent to verify an API surface from build artifacts instead of migrating complete source inputs.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: SafeTypes.g.cs confirmed the PowerGrid API shape.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Complete linked-item bootstrap inventory so binary reverse inspection is unnecessary.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent inspected multiple generated files and output.json across several turns after WMC9999.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Three failed builds and roughly 10 diagnostic/edit turns.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: WMC9999 was secondary to earlier specific compiler errors, while skill text presented it as a missing-resource diagnosis.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent fixed earlier type/binding and Launcher errors; the next build succeeded.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Tell agents to resolve preceding CS/WMC diagnostics before interpreting WMC9999.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Standalone Test-AppLaunch missed the build, then foreground dotnet run remained active until the trial timed out.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One false unavailable result and one non-terminating final command.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Layout discovery assumed bin\x64\Debug, followed by a redundant foreground launch after validator PASS.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Validator's platform-qualified rebuild and detached smoke launch passed; the foreground process itself did not finish in-budget.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make Test-AppLaunch discover both default and platform-qualified layouts; follow the existing validator/Test-AppLaunch launch discipline.

env_issues.workaround: Use repository-native PowerShell/search tools rather than introducing Python for inspection.

env_issues.issue: Original UWP baseline remained on the platform sample splash screen.
env_issues.workaround: The scoring trial limited both feature verdicts to partial despite the candidate parity tool reporting 2/2 pass; this is evaluation context, not a migration-skill change.
